recipes.name: Summer Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

Halve pie dough. Roll out ½ pastry dough on a floured work surface into a circle to fit a 9-inch pie plate; place bottom crust in pie plate. Roll remaining ½ pastry dough into a 10-inch circle; set top crust aside.
Combine whole strawberries, rhubarb, 1 cup sugar, flour, butter, and nutmeg in a bowl; pour into bottom crust. Combine 1 tablespoon sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl; set aside.

Cut top crust into ¾-inch wide strips (use a scalloped edge pastry cutter for a prettier crust). Moisten the rim of the bottom crust with a small amount of water. Start with the longest strips and lay the first 2 strips in a cross (X) in the center of the pie. Working from the next longest down to the shortest strips (using the shortest strips for the edges of the lattice), alternate horizontal and vertical strips, weaving them in an over-and-under pattern. Press the lattice strips down onto the bottom crust edge to seal; trim top crust strips neatly.

Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes; reduce heat to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Remove pie; sprinkle top with cinnamon-sugar mixture, and return to oven. Bake until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbling, about 30 minutes more.

raw_recipe.headline: Summer Strawberry Rhubarb Pie
raw_recipe.description: This strawberry rhubarb pie recipe has a sweet and juicy strawberry and rhubarb filling, topped with a golden lattice crust to make a summery dessert.

review.reviewBody: Loved it!!!!! Wouldn't change a thing.

I heated the filling in a sauce pan until I thought it was thick. There was little spillage but I had a pan under it. I didn't read the instructions completely and put the cinnamon in the filling, the flavor is awesome. I will be making this again.

Fantastic! I used more rhubarb than strawberries and only a scant one cup sugar because I prefer more of a slightly tart pie. Everything else was to the recipe. I've never made a lattice top crust before ; it is easier than I thought it would be. This is the second time I've made this pie in one week! Yummo!!

I am a rookie baker and this pie turned out really great! I over did the nutmeg a bit since I didn't pre-measure it (just grated it in the bowl). I followed the advice of one review and combined all the ingredients in a sauce pan over medium heat first to taste and after it cooled I added it to the crust.

Also, I brushed a beaten egg and water mix over the top crust before putting it in the oven to assist in getting a golden crust.

I was unsure about the whole berries but it worked really well!

Overall a very nice recipe and so easy!!

We went strawberry picking and wanted to try this type of as I was gifted a good amount of rhubarb. This is one of the best tasting fruit pies ever! I used store bought pie crust and cinnamon to the filling. It baked beautifully. I am saving this recipe to make again.

Excellent flavor. Whole strawberries cooked down nicely, but added a nice texture contrast to the cooked down rhubarb. I would add a thickener such as corn starch or tapioca. Unfortunately, my pie was a bit runny after cutting. Ideas?
This pie came out perfectly! The sweetness is just right, though I did skimp on the sugar by about 1/4 cup. Highly recommended.
Thanks to your guidance I was so proud of myself and to serve it.
I followed the recipe but added a little more strawberries and rhubarb for a little more flavor
This recipe was so easy and tasted amazing. I wouldn't change anything. This was my first Strawberry Rhubarb Pie that I have ever made and my husband loves it.
I loved this recipe and will definitely make it again. No changes at all.
I love making this pie... I just can't get enough it's. It's one of my favorite holiday or summer treats to make..ummhh ummhhh.
Came out a little runny at first. Let it cool completely and it is perfect!!
